attributes.board_name: New Jersey Physician Assistant Advisory Committee (State Board of Medical Examiners)

rules.new_licensee_rule: May be able to complete less CE in the first period of licensure.
rules.notes: Licenses valid 2 years, expire in August of odd-numbered years; CE due before renewal (Aug 31). CE standards in N.J.A.C. 13:35-2B.8. Committee FAQ (Category I detail) could not be read.
rules.rule_quote: Registered physician assistants must complete 50 credits during each two-year period
